identity.description: Finds public datasets for brain-tech research: "which dataset for motor imagery?" or "details on BCI IV-2a". Answers from a directory seeded from the corpus abstracts (modality, task, subjects/classes, benchmark SOTA, and the corpus papers that use each dataset). LLM-free — pure retrieval from data/datasets.json, instant and near-free.

inputs.description: Which dataset for a task? Or a dataset name for its full card (e.g. "details on WAY-EEG-GAL", "dataset for seizure detection", "all datasets")
inputs.example: Which dataset should I use for cross-subject motor imagery decoding?

outputs.description: Ranked dataset cards (id, task, modality, subjects/classes, license, benchmark SOTA)
Corpus papers that use/mention the datasets, as structured JSON (title, year, arXiv URL)

tags.name: Brain Technology
tags.description: Research on BCI, EEG decoding, neural decoding, connectomics and deep learning
